omniwheel.tutorial.manager.overview.body: This read-only tour shows the real interface without changing your profiles. Everything stays visible; the bright area is the current topic. Use Back and Next to review steps, or Skip to leave.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.profiles.body: Profiles keep separate wheel setups. Select one to edit; Activate makes it the wheel you actually open. New Profile, Rename, and Delete manage them. Drag a profile by its row or grip to reorder the profile list.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.entries.title: Entries and submenus
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.entries.body: Select an entry to edit it. Click a submenu chevron once, or double-click its row, to expand or collapse its children. Drag rows or grips to reorder the list. Drop on a submenu to move inside; drop beside a parent-level entry to move back out. Reordering within one list leaves radial positions unchanged; Preview arranges the wheel.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.create.title: Create and remove entries
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.create.body: Choose New Command, New Chat, New Function, New Keybind, or New Submenu. Delete removes the selected entry. Activate and Deactivate enable or disable it. Disabled entries keep their wheel positions but cannot run.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.appearance.bo: Name and Description explain an entry. Click the icon selector to open the browser. Shown and Hidden control the label, icon, and shortcut display. Hidden or missing icons leave their list space to the text. GUI Color sets the wheel tint; Text Color sets the entry label color. The rainbow + opens a custom picker.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.colors.title: Choose a custom color
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.colors.body: Click the rainbow + in either palette. Use the hue bar and large color area, or enter or paste a six-digit hex color. Before shows your saved color; After shows the proposed color. Apply saves it; Cancel or Escape leaves it unchanged. Text Color changes the entry label; GUI Color tints the wheel. This guide keeps the picker read-only.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.icons.title: Find an icon
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.icons.body: Search matches icons in every category, including collapsed categories. Expand Blocks, Items, Extras, or automatically named mod categories with the chevron or a double-click. Click an icon to select it. Only validated icons are listed.
Add from Inventory / GUI opens a flat grid of your available items. Choose one to copy its trims, enchantments, dyes, and other data; Back cancels selection. Import PNG accepts transparency and trims empty outer edges. Both kinds appear under Custom in the main browser and stay available without the original item or file.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.actions.title: Send or prepare a preset
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.actions.body: Chat and Command entries can send their text immediately or open it as an editable preset. The Send / Preset button switches the mode. Presets wait for you to press Enter in Minecraft chat. Other text actions can copy to the clipboard or show a message only to you.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.commands.body: A command entry can run several commands in order. Add Command adds a row; the minus button removes one. Drag a row by its label or grip to change the sequence. Preset mode is available only when there is one command. Server permissions still apply.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.data.title: Insert live information
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.data.body: Insert Data opens this searchable list. Choose readable player, world, target-block, target-entity, or held-item information; the correct placeholder is inserted at your cursor. Now shows a current value; Example shows the expected format. Values fill in when the entry runs. Missing targets show a helpful message.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.keybinds.body: Functions provide built-in actions. Keybind entries imitate a Minecraft or mod keybinding. Expand its category with the chevron or a double-click, then select a binding. Search matches names, IDs, and categories, including collapsed groups. The original binding can remain unassigned in Minecraft Controls. Required mods and game permissions still apply.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.shortcuts.bod: Click Shortcut and press the desired key or mouse button, optionally with modifiers. Extra mouse buttons and keyboard keys received by Minecraft are supported. Backspace clears it; Escape ends recording. Shortcuts run entries directly. Controls opens Minecraft Controls; Shown / Hidden only changes the displayed shortcut.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.preview.title: Arrange the actual wheel
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.preview.body: Preview shows the selected profile with its real wheel positions. Drag an entry to see a lifted copy and its landing position. Release to save; Escape cancels the drag. Entries-list ordering stays independent. Activate this profile when you want to use it in-game.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.moving.title: Submenus and pages in Preview
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.moving.body: Stacked entries are submenus. Drop into their inner area to move an entry inside, or hover there while dragging to open them. The center Back target moves an entry out. Use or hover the side arrows to cross pages. The corner Back returns to the editor.
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.finish.title: Keyboard and saving
omniwheel.tutorial.manager.finish.body: Changes save automatically. Tab and arrow keys move through the management interface and its browsers; Enter or Space activates the focused control. Escape cancels a drag, leaves text editing, or goes back. Help restarts this guide and the wheel guide. Your original selection returns when this tour ends.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.opening.title: Open your wheel
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.opening.body: Hold %s to open the wheel. Normally, releasing it runs the highlighted entry. During this read-only guide, actions are paused so you can look around safely. Back and Next review the guide; Skip leaves it.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.selection.body: Move the mouse toward an entry; distance does not need to be exact. Release the wheel key to activate it, or click an entry. The selected wedge grows smoothly. Greyed-out entries are unavailable in your current game state.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.submenus.title: Stacked entries are submenus
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.submenus.body: A stacked entry opens another wheel rather than running a final action. Select it to enter, then choose an entry inside. Submenus can contain further submenus. Your current profile determines the available entries.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.center.title: Back or cancel
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.center.body: At the main wheel, returning to the center cancels without running an entry. Inside a submenu, the center becomes Back and takes you to the parent wheel. Escape closes the menu.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.pages.title: More than eight entries
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.pages.body: A wheel can have several pages. Scroll the mouse wheel to change pages; the center shows the page count. Each page keeps the positions arranged in Preview, including entries that are currently unavailable.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.keyboard.title: Keys and direct shortcuts
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.keyboard.body: Directional wheel keybindings can select entries without the mouse. Their default layout follows the numpad; the center binding goes back or cancels. Entries can also have their own direct keyboard or mouse shortcuts, configured in the manager.
omniwheel.tutorial.radial.management.bod: Press %s to open management. There you can edit entries, pick icons, insert live information, imitate vanilla or mod keybindings, and use Preview to rearrange the wheel. Profile changes save automatically.
